resources.string: Move to the new Nyanime

This update prepares the move from your old Nyanime to the new one. We updated the package and signing identity, so Android treats them as separate apps.\n\nInstall the new Nyanime from the official website, open it and choose Bring my data. After verification you can remove this old version.
Get or open the new Nyanime
Checking the new app’s availability…
The new app is not available yet. Try again shortly.
We couldn’t check the download. Check your connection and try again.
Move to the new Nyanime
Prepare
Transfer
Verify

You are moving from your old Nyanime to the new one. The new package and production signing identity make Android treat them as separate apps.\n\nBring your library, progress, settings, extensions and downloads into the new app. You will confirm the transfer in your old Nyanime.
Your previous app and its data stay on this device. Nothing is removed automatically.
Transfer to the new Nyanime?
Allow the verified production version of Nyanime to receive your private data, including saved credentials. This app will pause while a consistent copy is prepared. The transfer stays on your device.
Allow transfer
Not now
Moving your Nyanime
We are preparing a consistent copy of your data. This app becomes usable again as soon as the copy is ready, even if the transfer is interrupted.
You can use the previous Nyanime
Preparation has finished. You can keep using this version: the transfer uses a separate copy and does not change your original data.
Error code: %1$s
Cancel transfer
Repeat the transfer from the previous version. Data in the new app is replaced only after verification.
Bring my data
Transfer complete
Your library, saved progress, settings and private files have been checked. Shared downloads remain in their original folder.
Open Nyanime
Opening Nyanime…
Preparing a copy of your data. This may take a few minutes if you have many downloads: keep both apps installed.
Copying your data into the new Nyanime. Once copied, we will check that the transfer is complete.
Copying is finished. We are now checking your library, progress, settings and files: the transfer is complete only after verification.
%1$d%% · %2$s of %3$s copied
Remove the old app
Just one Nyanime

Your transfer into the new Nyanime has been verified. Would you like to uninstall the previous version to avoid confusing the two apps?\n\nAndroid will ask for confirmation. Your transferred data stays in the new Nyanime. If you prefer to check it first, you can remove the old app later in Settings → Data and storage.
Your transfer is verified. Open Android’s uninstall confirmation.
Could not open Android’s confirmation. Please try from your phone’s settings.
After checking your library and downloads, you can remove the old Nyanime. Android will ask for confirmation; the data transferred to the new app remains available.
Transfer not completed
Your previous app is intact. Check free space and folder access, then try again. Existing data in the new app is preserved if verification fails.
Try again
First update your previous Nyanime to the transition version. If Android blocks it, use its complete backup or Nyanime Recovery; keep the previous app installed.
Open previous Nyanime
Set up without transferring
Allow access to the same folder
Android needs your permission for the new app to use the existing download folder. Choose the same folder used by your previous Nyanime. Files will not be duplicated.
Choose the original Nyanime folder, not a different location.
